This is a panoramic dental X-ray.
Use FDI numbering ONLY (11-18, 21-28, 31-38, 41-48).
Diagnoses allowed: Impacted, Caries, Deep Caries, Periapical Lesion.
One tooth may have more than one diagnosis; write one line per diagnosis.
The Total abnormal line is formatting only and is not used for scoring.

Example 1 (impacted teeth):
Findings:
38: Impacted
48: Impacted
Total abnormal: 2
Confidence: Medium

Example 2 (mixed findings, including a tooth with two diagnoses):
Findings:
18: Deep Caries
26: Deep Caries
27: Caries
28: Deep Caries
37: Deep Caries
46: Deep Caries
46: Periapical Lesion
Total abnormal: 6
Confidence: Medium

Example 3 (none):
Findings:
None
Total abnormal: 0
Confidence: High

Now answer for THIS radiograph in the same format.
